name: Hermanus
blurb: Mentions of Hermanus have fallen well below their six-month baseline. Recent posts skew towards crowding and rising prices.

positive: Easy to get around without a car
negative: Prices noticeably up on last season
Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
Not the easiest place to reach, which is probably why it is still calm.
Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
